item.name: Export Daily New Users by Date

request.name: Export Daily New Users by Date

description.content:
> Use this endpoint to retrieve a daily series of the total number of new users on each date. 
  

Note: If you are using our [older navigation](https://www.braze.com/docs/navigation), `app_id` can be found at **Developer Console** > **API Settings**.

To use this endpoint, youll need to generate an API key with the `kpi.new_users.data_series` permission.

## Rate limit

We apply the default Braze rate limit of 250,000 requests per hour to this endpoint, as documented in [API rate limits](https://www.braze.com/docs/api/api_limits/).

## Response

``` json
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer YOUR-REST-API-KEY
{
    "message": (required, string) the status of the export, returns 'success' when completed without errors,
    "data" : [
        {
            "time" : (string) the date as ISO 8601 date,
            "new_users" : (int) the number of daily new users
        },
        ...
    ]
}

```

> **Tip:** For help with CSV and API exports, visit [Export troubleshooting](https://www.braze.com/docs/user_guide/data_and_analytics/export_braze_data/export_troubleshooting/).

query.description:
(Required) Integer

Maximum number of days before `ending_at` to include in the returned series. Must be between 1 and 100 (inclusive).

(Optional) Datetime ([ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) string)

Date on which the data series should end. Defaults to time of the request.

(Optional) String

App API identifier retrieved from **Settings > Setup and Testing > API Keys**. If excluded, results for all apps in workspace will be returned.

The Braze and Radar integration allows you to access sophisticated location-based campaign triggers and user profile enrichment with rich, first-party location data. When Radar geofence or trip tracking events are generated, custom events and user attributes are sent to Braze in real-time. These events and attributes can then be used to trigger location-based campaigns, power last-mile pickup and delivery operations, monitor fleet and shipping logistics, or build user segments based on location patterns.
